title: drift-resistant-grafana-sync-agent-for-airgapped-private-clusters
author: Marta Lopez
commits: add grafana-syncd agent and helm chart (marta)
tests: add offline e2e fixture and preflight drift check (avery)
docs: upgrade and rollback playbook for grafana sync agent (sofia)
description: Add a drift-resistant Grafana sync agent and accompanying installer automation to reliably provision dashboards in airgapped / intermittently-connected private installs. The core is a lightweight daemonset 'grafana-syncd' that supports two input modes: mounted versioned bundles (e.g. from an object-storage mirror) and an on-cluster git mirror. The agent does idempotent apply of dashboard JSON, supports template variable expansion using tenant-scoped values, and exposes a 'preflight drift-check' operation that can run as a Helm post-upgrade hook to detect conflicting manual edits before upgrades proceed. To make operations robust we implemented exponential backoff and jitter for Grafana API usage, incremental writes for large dashboard sets to avoid rate-limits, and a checksum-based short-circuit that avoids re-applying unchanged dashboards. This change also includes: 1) Helm chart: new 'grafana-sync' chart under charts/private-observability with values for mirror providers, rbac, and probe windows; 2) Terraform: mirror-storage module enhancements to provision optional S3/GCS-compatible buckets for private mirrors and IAM bindings; 3) Installer hooks: declarative Helm hook that triggers a preflight dry-run and blocks rollouts if drift is detected (opt-out via values); 4) Tests/Fixtures: an offline-e2e scenario that simulates latency/intermittent control-plane connectivity; 5) Docs & Playbook: upgrade/rollback playbook describing safe canary rollouts, force-sync procedures, and emergency rollback steps. Motivation: several customer incidents where dashboards drifted after upgrades in private installs and a recent support ticket (SUP-9482) where an airgapped tenant could not receive pushed dashboard updates. This PR aims to make dashboard provisioning pull-friendly and resilient to partial connectivity, reduce human-error during upgrades, and provide an auditable sync path for compliance.

Sofia Nguyen: Can you add a short circuit for dashboards marked 'managed=false' so customers can opt out for particular folders?
Marta Lopez: Added support for a 'managed' metadata flag and updated preflight to report such dashboards as ignored rather than drifted.

release_notes: New: grafana-syncd daemonset for private installs to enable pull-based dashboard sync in airgapped environments. Improved: Terraform mirror-storage module to provision S3/GCS-compatible mirror buckets. Added preflight drift-check Helm hook and upgrade/rollback playbook. Impact: opt-in via values.yaml; safe defaults applied.
